parameters.name: Email
parameters.description:
The email address of the recipient.
> You must specify at least one of Phone or Email.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~462953~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the recipient. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, cannot start with a special character, and can contain only the following special characters: periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), backslashes (\), and spaces.

parameters.name: Phone
parameters.description:
The phone number of the recipient.
> You must specify at least one of Phone or Email.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The project ID.
> You can call the ListProjects operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
